description_en: Performs a paging query for the exact object type subscriptions of a digital worker
description_zh: 分页查询数字员工精确对象类型关注
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo list-operating-object-favorites --graph-name crm --operating-object-name customer_assistant --object-type contract --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperatingObjectFavorites

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If specified, the operation is executed as the user identified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the effective tenant
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the graph. You can call the listGraphs operation to obtain the graph name
parameters.help_zh: 图谱名称，可先调用 listGraphs 获取
parameters.name: graph_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the digital worker, which is the name of the operating object. This parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: 数字员工名称（运营对象 name，可选）
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The object type, such as customer. This parameter has a value when type is set to mention
parameters.help_zh: 对象类型如 customer，type=mention 时有值
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

graphName.description_en: The name of the graph. You can call the listGraphs operation to obtain the graph name
graphName.description_zh: 图谱名称，可先调用 listGraphs 获取

items.description_en: The list of results. The maximum size is 50

description.description_en: The description of the to-do card type

followedAt.description_en: The subscription time, which is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
followedAt.description_zh: 关注时间，Unix 秒级时间戳

objectId.description_en: The ID of the recommended item, which can be a feedId or a mini-app ID
objectId.description_zh: 推荐物品的ID，可以是feedId或者是微应用ID

objectType.description_en: The object type of the attached object, such as customer or project
objectType.description_zh: 绑定对象类型（如 customer / project）

message.description_en: The description of the status code

objectType.description_en: The object type, such as customer. This parameter has a value when type is set to mention
objectType.description_zh: 对象类型如 customer，type=mention 时有值

operatingObjectName.description_en: The name of the digital worker, which is the name of the operating object
operatingObjectName.description_zh: 数字员工名称（运营对象 name）

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

total.description_en: The total number of Logtail pipeline configurations in the current project
total.description_zh: 当前Project下的Logtail流水线配置总数
